B MODELLING BACTERIA (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
In an experiment a biologist recorded the number of bacteria in a dish at the end of each day for 5 days.
The table shows the results.
Time in days (x) 1 2 3 4 5
Number of bacteria (n) 120 170 250 370 530

1 2 3 4 5
